svg.title: Infrastructure Viability Geometry V4
svg.desc: Computed browser-model trajectories for power, water, transport and solid waste, with composite service and a power-water phase portrait containing the model viability threshold region.

g.text: Computed state trajectories before geometric interpretation.
Existing P–W–T–SW browser model · illustrative parameters · verification is not field validation.
The trajectories and thresholds are computed from the repository model. Parameters are illustrative; this figure is not a calibrated digital twin or empirical prediction.
Trace: assets/model.js → simulate() → summarize() → this SVG → CI structural/render/regression tests.
